title.id: No available channels (tidak ada channel tersedia)

cause.en: The relay has no channel that serves this model for your group: the user group, the channel group or the channel's model list do not line up.
cause.id: Relay tidak punya channel yang melayani model ini untuk grupmu: grup pengguna, grup channel, atau daftar model channel tidak cocok.

user_fix.en: Check the exact model name, and use a key or group that includes this model. Otherwise contact the relay admin.
user_fix.id: Cek nama model persisnya, dan pakai key atau grup yang mencakup model ini. Kalau tidak, hubungi admin relay.

operator_fix.en: Check user group settings, channel group settings and channel model settings so the model is served for that group.
operator_fix.id: Cek pengaturan grup pengguna, grup channel, dan model channel supaya model dilayani untuk grup tersebut.

message: invalid character '<' looking for beginning of value

title.en: invalid character '<' looking for beginning of value
title.id: invalid character '<' looking for beginning of value (upstream membalas HTML)

cause.en: The upstream returned an HTML page instead of JSON. The relay docs name a blocked server IP or proxy node (for example blocked by Cloudflare) as the most likely reason.
cause.id: Upstream membalas halaman HTML, bukan JSON. Dokumentasi relay menyebut IP server atau node proxy yang diblokir (misalnya oleh Cloudflare) sebagai penyebab paling mungkin.

user_fix.en: Report it to the relay admin; it is not caused by your request.
user_fix.id: Laporkan ke admin relay; ini bukan karena request-mu.

operator_fix.en: Open the channel's base URL from the server and see which HTML page comes back; fix the base URL or the blocked egress IP.
operator_fix.id: Buka base URL channel dari server dan lihat halaman HTML apa yang kembali; perbaiki base URL atau IP keluar yang diblokir.

title.id: Ratio or price not configured (harga model belum diatur)

cause.en: The relay runs in billing mode and the model has no ratio or price set.
cause.id: Relay berjalan dalam mode berbayar dan model belum punya ratio atau harga.

user_fix.en: Ask the relay admin to set a price for the model, or use another model.
user_fix.id: Minta admin relay mengatur harga model, atau pakai model lain.

operator_fix.en: Set the model ratio or price in the operation settings, or enable self-use mode for a private deployment.
operator_fix.id: Atur ratio atau harga model di pengaturan operasional, atau aktifkan mode pemakaian sendiri untuk deployment pribadi.

title.en: Current group load is saturated, please try again later
title.id: Current group load is saturated (beban grup penuh)

cause.en: An upstream channel answered 429 Too Many Requests.
cause.id: Channel upstream menjawab 429 Too Many Requests.

user_fix.en: Retry later with backoff, or try another model.
user_fix.id: Ulangi nanti dengan backoff, atau coba model lain.

operator_fix.en: Add capacity or more channels to the group, and lower per-channel concurrency.
operator_fix.id: Tambah kapasitas atau channel ke grup, dan turunkan paralel per channel.

title.en: Insufficient quota (although the account has quota)
title.id: Insufficient quota (padahal saldo akun masih ada)

cause.en: Token (API key) quota and account quota are separate. The key's own quota limit can run out while the account still has balance.
cause.id: Kuota token (API key) dan kuota akun itu terpisah. Batas kuota key bisa habis walaupun akun masih punya saldo.

user_fix.en: Raise the quota of the key (or set it to no limit) in the API keys page, or top up the account if it is empty.
user_fix.id: Naikkan kuota key (atau hapus batasnya) di halaman API key, atau isi saldo akun kalau memang kosong.

operator_fix.en: Explain in your UI that key quota is a cap set by the user, separate from the wallet balance.
operator_fix.id: Jelaskan di UI bahwa kuota key adalah batas yang diatur pengguna, terpisah dari saldo dompet.
